newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ZUBIZARRETA ERROR HANDS BARCELONA A POINT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ZUBIZARRETA ERROR HANDS BARCELONA A POINT.

text.p: A mistake by Valencia goalkeeper Andoni Zubizarreta helped Barcelona salvage a point from a thrilling Mediterranean derby on Sunday to keep alive their slim Spanish title aspirations.
Zubizarreta had pulled off a series of fine saves to deny his former team mates after Leandro had put Valencia ahead in the 42nd minute.

But the veteran Spanish international was badly at fault midway through the second half when he allowed a cross from Hristo Stoichkov to sail over his head and straight to Ronaldo who scored with ease.
Ronaldo's equaliser made up for several missed chances, two of them in a frantic opening five minutes.
With 11 games left to play in the Spanish championship, Barcelona trail Real Madrid by eight points. That gap may be widened later on Sunday when the leaders play at Tenerife.
Barcelona held on to second place on goal difference from Real Betis, whose game at struggling Espanyol finished goalless.
